s-1.ptxt: Install Front Door Outside Moulding LH

s2.ptxt: Clean Vehicle Installation Surface (When Using Solvent)

s3.ptxt: Apply protective tape right up to the edge of the acrylic foam tape remaining on the body.

atten4.ptxt: To protect the body, it is recommended to also apply masking tape around the protective tape.

s3.ptxt: Using a plastic spatula or brush, apply Remover Bond 7 as thickly as possible to the acrylic foam tape remaining on the body.

item.ptxt: Shake the can of Remover Bond 7 well to stir it before use.
Do not use Remover Bond 7 on air-dried paint films.
If Remover Bond 7 gets directly on the paint surface, it may cause the paint film to swell, so wipe it off immediately.
If the paint film swells, heat the affected area to 80°C with an infrared lamp, and repeat several times the work of pressing a shop rag soaked in thinner onto it every 4-5 minutes to let it soak in.

s3.ptxt: Heat the acrylic foam tape remaining on the body using an infrared lamp or equivalent.

atten3.ptxt: If it is heated until the surface dries white, the acrylic foam tape will be difficult to peel off in the next step, so stop heating before then.

s3.ptxt: Scrape off the acrylic foam tape remaining on the body using a plastic spatula.

atten3.ptxt: Make the acrylic foam tape sufficiently thin before proceeding to the next step.

s3.ptxt: Apply Remover Bond 7 again to the acrylic foam tape remaining on the body.
Heat the acrylic foam tape remaining on the body using an infrared lamp or equivalent.

atten3.ptxt: Allow the acrylic foam tape to dry to the inside. (The surface dries white)

s3.ptxt: Rub off the acrylic foam tape remaining on the body with a shop rag or equivalent.

atten3.ptxt: If acrylic foam tape remains, apply Remover Bond 7 and scrape it off with a plastic spatula. Remove the protective tape and clean the body with white gasoline.

s2.ptxt: Clean Vehicle Installation Surface (When Using Tape Removable Disc)

s3.ptxt: Apply protective tape right up to the edge of the acrylic foam tape remaining on the body.

atten4.ptxt: To protect the body, it is recommended to also apply masking tape around the protective tape.

s3.ptxt: Set 8 discs in the holder, and install the removable disc to an air drill or electric drill.

atten3.ptxt: Use an electric drill with a no-load speed of 2000-3000r/min.

s3.ptxt: Wearing protective goggles, scrape off the acrylic foam tape.

item.ptxt: Pay attention to the disc rotation direction and work progress direction.
To avoid damaging the body by scraping too much, visually check the area being scraped while working.

s3.ptxt: Clean the bonding surface with white gasoline.
As with the vehicle installation surface, remove the acrylic foam tape using solvent or a tape removable disc.

atten3.ptxt: When using a tape removable disc, secure the moulding in a vise or equivalent with a shop rag placed against it.

s3.ptxt: Apply acrylic foam tape to the back of the moulding. (When reusing moulding)
Heat the moulding and body surface.
Peel off the release paper of the acrylic foam tape without touching the adhesive surface.
Set the front door outside moulding on the vehicle, and install it by pressing it firmly with a roller.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Door Outside Moulding LH

s2.ptxt: Install the rear door outside moulding LH in the same way as the front door outside moulding LH.
